{{as|{{pplevel|{{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_s}} to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_s}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_s}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} and {{pplevel|({{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_s}} to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_s}})*{{#var:i_heal}}|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_s}}*{{#var:i_heal}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|{{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_maxd}} to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} and {{pplevel|({{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_maxd}} to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_maxd}})*{{#var:i_heal}}|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}*{{#var:i_heal}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} over the duration.|{{as|{{pplevel|{{#var:i_1}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}) to {{#var:i_18}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}})}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}})}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Briar''' for {{pplevel|({{#var:i_1}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}) to {{#var:i_18}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}))*{{#var:i_heal}}|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:i_ad}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}})*{{#var:i_heal}})}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} every {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_s}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}))*{{#var:i_heal}}|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_s}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}))*{{#var:i_heal}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} for each subsequent stack respectively and up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|{{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}) to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}})}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}})}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{pplevel|({{#var:i_1}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}) to {{#var:i_18}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}))*{{#var:i_heal}}|color=heal}}  {{as|(+ {{ap|({{#var:i_ad}}*{{#var:i_maxd}}/({{#var:i_dotd}}/{{#var:i_dotr}}))*{{#var:i_heal}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} per tick.}}If a target dies while bleeding, she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage.
|description2 = '''Briar''' has no {{sti|health regeneration|{{as|'''base''' health regeneration}}}}, but she increases healing from all sources by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 40 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.4% per 1% missing health}}|health}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type='''missing''' health|0 to 2.5 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.025% per 1% missing health}}|health}} per 100 '''bonus''' health)}}.

|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = proc
|parry        = true

** Because of this, '''Briar''' will not heal on {{tip|invulnerable}} targets.
* {{ais|Blood Frenzy|Briar}} area of effect damage around the target does not apply bleed stacks.
<!-- Blurb --> 
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Briar}} has no {{sti|health regeneration|{{as|'''base''' health regeneration}}}} but she gains increased healing from other sources based on her {{as|'''missing''' health}}.

|blurb3       = If a target affected by her bleed dies, '''Briar''' heals for the remaining amount.

Q.name: Head Rush
Q.title: Template:Data Briar/Head Rush
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Head Rush|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Briar
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Briar Head Rush.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.85}} seconds, and reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 5 seconds.
|description2 = ''Head Rush {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Resistances Reduction|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|13 to 9}}
|cdstart      = 
|cost         = {{as|5%|health}}
|costtype     = {{as|'''current''' Health}}
|cast time    = none
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 475
|speed        = {{pp|type=distance|600 to 600+300|0 to 450 for 10|formula=600 base + 300 over the target range}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = spell
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|notes        = 
* ''Head Rush'' can be cast on [[jungle plants]], {{tip|wards}}, and {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}.
** It cannot be cast on {{tip|structures}}.
* ''Head Rush'' does not force the target's armor and magic resistance to update immediately outside of the {{tt|natural stat update cycle|once every 0.25 seconds}}, meaning its damage will typically still be mitigated by the unreduced armor value.
* ''Head Rush's'' damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
* ''Head Rush'' is a non-following dash.
** It picks its dash destination ~100 units in front of enemy targets, 75 units in front of enemy targets when already very close to them, 75 units in front of allied targets. 
** If already within 75 units of her target, she dashes to her current location, which takes 0 time but still triggers dash effects such as {{ri|Sudden Impact}}.
<!-- Blurb --> 
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Briar}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them briefly, and additionally reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for a few seconds.
|blurb4       = ''Head Rush'' applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
}}

W.name: Snack Attack

W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Snack Attack|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Briar
|skill        = W
|icon         = Briar Snack Attack.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds during ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' to take a bite out of the target enemy, gaining {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} her for {{as|5% of her '''maximum''' health}} plus a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% AD)}} {{as|(+ 9% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
{{st|Heal Percentage|{{ap|24 to 40}}%}}
|description2 = ''Snack Attack'' deals 110% damage against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, with the damage based on the target's health ratio being capped at 400.
|leveling2    = {{st|Non-Champion Bonus Damage|{{ap|5*1.1 to 65*1.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.1}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|9*1.1}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
|description3 = ''Snack Attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Briar's''' basic attack timer.''
|cast time    = none
|target range = 
|width        = 
|speed        = 
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = spell
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* ''Snack Attack'' can only be used during ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}''; if the frenzy ends at any point, the empowered attack will be lost immediately.
* ''Snack Attack'' can be cast while '''Briar''' is {{tip|charm|charmed}} or {{tip|taunt|taunted}}.{{bug}}
<!-- Blurb --> 
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Briar}} empowers her next attack during {{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}} to take a bite out of the target enemy. The attack gains increased {{sti|range}}, deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the target's {{as|'''missing''' health|health}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Briar''' for a portion of the damage dealt.
}}

{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Certain Death|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Briar |skill = R |icon = Briar Certain Death.png |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Briar''' kicks her pillory's hemolith in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Can grant sight of area into brush and through terrain}} as it {{tt|travels|creates vision bubbles every 0.25 seconds}} and marking the first enemy champion hit as her prey. The mark's application {{tip|disrupt|disrupts}} the target's ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}. While the target is marked, they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. |description2 = If a target is hit, '''Briar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} herself from all {{tip|crowd control}} and becomes {{tip|cc-immune|immune to them}} over a cast time, afterwards {{tip|dash|dashing}} to them with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies and {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked targets for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%. She then enters a state of ''Hematomania''. |leveling2 = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}} |icon3 = Briar Certain Death 2.png |description3 = {{sbc|Hematomania:}} '''Briar''' gains all effects of ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}, {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''additional bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. |leveling3 = {{st|Life Steal|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}} {{st|Additional Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}} |icon4 = Briar Certain Death 3.png |description4 = While in the empowered frenzy, '''Briar''' prioritizes attacking the marked target over all other units and regardless of range. If that target becomes invalid, she will shift back to her {{tt|normal targeting priority|nearest non-marked champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit}} until the marked target can be attacked again. ''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death. |description5 = ''Casting {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} removes the target's mark and ends Hematomania early. {{ais|Head Rush|Briar}} cast does not shift her targeting priority during Hematomania.'' |cooldown = {{ap|120 to 80}} |cdstart = on-cast |cost = {{as|5%|health}} |costtype = {{as|'''current''' Health}} |cast time = {{dv|{{tt|1|Time before kicking hemolith}}|{{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Time before dashing to target}}}} |range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|12000|Missile range}} |width = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|320|Missile width}} |effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|Global|Second cast dash range and frenzy marked/non-marked target radius (see notes)}}|{{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|1500|Frenzy non-marked target radius}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|575|Fear radius on impact around target}}}} |speed = {{dv|{{tt|2000|Missile speed}}|{{tt|2500 – 5000|Dash speed, accelerates over time}}}} |queue time = {{fd|0.5}} |targeting = Direction |affects = Enemies, Self |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = true |spelleffects = spellaoe |projectile = true |grounded = true |knockdown = false |flavorsound = [[File:Briar_Original_SFX_R_cast_warning.ogg]] {{tt|''Activation alert.|Plays after the initial cast time}}''
{{sm2|Briar_Original_RHit_0.ogg}} ''"'''FOUND YOU!!'''"'' |notes = * {{Pending for test}} The dash is considered an ability activation for the purposes of {{ii|Sheen}} and {{cai|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}. * '''Briar''' will track the target with the {{tip|dash}} if they change locations. ** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance. * '''Briar''' lands 100 units in front of her target at the end of the dash. * '''Briar''' will not initiate the second cast if she is being {{tip|suppression|suppressed}}, is under {{tip|resurrection}}, or is in the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} when her target is hit by the missile in the normal realm. ** Since ''Certain Death'' cleanses herself from all crowd control when the first cast hits, she will be able to start the second cast due to removing the suppression effect. * '''Briar''' will still dash to the target even if they die before she reaches them. * '''Briar''' will transition from having {{tip|cc-immune|total crowd control immunity}} during the cast time of the dash, to having {{tip|displacement immunity}} during the dash. * '''Briar''' will place herself onto the ground and interrupt {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting her upon starting the second cast time. * ''Hematomania's'' targeting priorities differ slightly from that of ''{{ais|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'': ** She will prioritize the marked target regardless of range and over all other units as long as it can be attacked. *** If the marked target is not available, then she shifts her priority to the nearest other champion, then large monster or minion, and then any other unit in a global radius. * Starting the second cast interrupts any spells that '''Briar''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}. * The mark will expire if ''Hematomania's'' buff is dispelled. * Casting ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' will not grant any additional bonuses nor will it override ''Hematomania's'' effects. ** Gaining ''Hematomania'' while ''Blood Frenzy'' is active will override the previous buff. ** Casting ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' during ''Hematomania'' does allow the use of ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}''. However, both ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'''s effects and the ability to use ''{{ai|Snack Attack|Briar}}'' are immediately interrupted upon exiting ''Hematomania''. * The {{tip|disrupt}} is 'wrapped' into a status effect that causes the affected champion to display the "{{tip|silence|Silenced}}" UI on their [[Health bar#Disabled state|health bar]] for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, without actually applying the disabling effects of the {{tip|silence}} crowd control type (functions as an indicator of the target becoming ''disrupted''). This however ensures that the ''disrupt'' is also prevented by effects that would negate {{tip|silence|silences}} (such as {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}}). * {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate at the end of ''Certain Death's'' initial cast time. If the missile hits a target, the buff's duration is refreshed at the end of the dash. {{Effect at cast time start}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Briar''' is in either the first or second cast time: {{ct|cast}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Briar''' is dashing: {{ct|cast=false|move=false|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Briar''' is in ''Hematomania'': {{ct|attack=Uncontrollable|move=Uncontrollable|cast=''{{ai|Head Rush|Briar}}'' can only be cast on targets within its radius. ''{{ai|E|Briar}}'' interrupts the frenzy. ''{{ai|R|Briar}}'' is disabled.|items=true|consume=true|spells=true,true,false,false|interrupts=death}} |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Briar}} kicks her pillory's hemolith a large distance toward the target direction which marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them. |blurb2 = If a target is hit, '''Briar''' destroys her pillory and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to them. Upon arrival, she creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the marked champion and enemies around them, and also {{tip|flee|fears}} all non-marked enemies. '''Briar''' then enters ''Hematomania''.
|blurb3 = {{sbc|Hematomania:}} '''Briar''' gains all effects of ''{{ai|Blood Frenzy|Briar}}'' against the marked target as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{as|{{sti|life steal}}|life steal}}, and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''additional bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}. ''Hematomania'' lasts until she or the marked target dies. |blurb4 = '''Briar''' can cast {{ai|Chilling Scream|Briar}} to end ''Hematomania'' early. }}
